raw_snippet: a pipeline that takes a freshly trained LoRA adapter and puts it behind a live, A/B routed, fully provenanced endpoint in roughly an hour. That is enough to run continual learning in production today
note: Baseten + Trajectory (co-authored by Trajectory's Elabd and Karanam): per-customer LoRA adapters merged and A/B-routed on a cadence, with provenance. L3: adapters per customer on a cadence; nothing per-session, so not L5.
